", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "年成本只要4000块，这TM是什么神仙生意", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你知道最狠的商业模式是什么吗？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不是收会员费。不是卖课程。是——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "完全免费，但广告收入年入300万美元。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Ivan Kutskir做到了。他一个人，花了13年，做了一个网页版Photoshop。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "叫Photopea。每天100万人用。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "年成本多少？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "域名20美元，服务器600美元。折合人民币不到5000块。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Ivan从来没想过创业。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他就是喜欢写代码。做点有用的，或者至少有趣的软件。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2012年，他还在读书。突发奇想：要不做个网页版的PSD文件查看器？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "花了两周做完。自己觉得挺酷，就一直维护着。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "每个月投入10小时。纯属爱好。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "没有商业计划。没有变现打算。就是看着用户增长，心里爽。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这种"爽"，是很多创业者丢失的东西。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "二、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "直到2017年，Photopea已经积累了5000日活。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Ivan才想起来：要不...放点广告？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "90%收入来自广告，10%来自付费会员（去广告）。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "就这么简单。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "没有销售团队。没有市场部。没有融资。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他一个人，写了所有的JavaScript代码。GLSL代码也是他自己写的。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "整个软件就是一个网页，用户打开就下载到本地运行。服务器只用来存用户信息（可选）和云存储（也是可选）。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "大部分用户，连账号都不用注册。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Ivan曾经很焦虑。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "13年了，他还是一个人。没团队，没公司，不知道怎么做大。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "后来他想通了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""我喜欢写代码。别人不一定喜欢，我也不喜欢指挥别人干活。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以他接受了这个状态。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "只要开心，一个人就一个人。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "还有件事让他庆幸——他没卖公司。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有人出价，但远低于他现在的收入。而且他说："我不想被管理。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "四、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Photopea是怎么火起来的？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "没有大推广大发布。Ivan2012年就上线了，当时只有现在1%的功能。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "连保存功能都没有。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但他保持每月更新。一点点加功能，一点点改进。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最开始，他把它提交到Google Experiments，每天来10-20个访客。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后有几家科技博客报道了，又多了10-20个。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "用户觉得好用，口口相传。 organically 就长大了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他也试过SEO，反复改网站结构和内容，但没太大用。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "真正起作用的，是网络上提到Photopea的次数。这个指标在慢慢增加，搜索引擎排名也跟着上去了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "内容为王，外链为皇。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "老生常谈，但真的有用。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "五、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Ivan给年轻人的建议是什么？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""先好好上学。25岁之前，专注教育。其他项目就当爱好。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这话从一个辍学大牛嘴里说出来，挺有意思的。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但他接着说："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""一旦决定创业，别怕犯错。你肯定会犯的。与其花一年找'完美点子'，不如一年试10个不完美的。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "动手干，比空想强一万倍。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "还有，相信直觉。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""如果某个决定感觉不对，就拒绝。别怕说'不'。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写在最后"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Ivan的故事最让我震撼的，不是收入数字。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "是他的"}, {"insert": "耐心", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "13年，一个人，从0做到100万日活。没有融资压力，没有增长焦虑，就是单纯做自己喜欢的事。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "赚钱，只是副产品。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在太多人想"快速致富"。三个月没起色就放弃，半年没盈利就 pivot。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但Ivan告诉我们——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "时间是你的朋友。如果你在做对的事，做久了，自然会有回报。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "当然，前提是，你得先做13年。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原文来自Indie Hackers，由AI翻译并改写", "attributes": {"italic": true}}]}
content_en: He alone made free Photoshop earning twenty one million yearly. Annual cost only four thousand dollars what kind of divine business do you know. Do you know the most ruthless business model. Not charging membership fee. Not selling courses. It is completely free but advertising revenue three hundred million dollars annually. Ivan Kutskir did it. He alone spent thirteen years made web version Photoshop. Called Photopea. One million people use daily. Annual cost how much. Domain twenty dollars server six hundred dollars. Less than five thousand RMB. One. Ivan never thought about entrepreneurship. He just likes writing code. Make useful or at least interesting software. Twenty twelve he was still in school. Had sudden idea why not make web based PSD file viewer. Spent two weeks finishing. Thought it was cool kept maintaining. Ten hours monthly. Pure hobby. No business plan. No monetization plan. Just watching user growth feels good. This kind of feeling is something many entrepreneurs lost. Two. Until twenty seventeen Photopea accumulated five thousand daily active users. Ivan then thought maybe put some advertising. Ninety percent income from advertising ten percent from paid members remove ads. That simple. No sales team. No marketing department. No financing. He alone.
